docs/specs/issue-lifecycle.spec.html `#gates-tiers` (accepted 2026-11-24 at 38721149, on main since 38ae99ff, spec PR #1248), docs/adr/0033.

## Expected

The merge ask check sorts every merge ask into tier 1, 2 or 3 from records the lane already has, prints the tier, each reason and whom the merge waits for (nobody, the director's order, the owner), and a supervisor merges a tier 1 or tier 2 ask itself when the ask names no open pull request the merge would set back.

Criteria this lane builds (docs/specs/issue-lifecycle.status.json, all planned): acceptance-tier-one, acceptance-tier-clarify, acceptance-tier-optout-cleared, acceptance-tier-optout-uncleared, acceptance-tier-adds, acceptance-tier-weakens, acceptance-tier-ruled, acceptance-tier-ruling-unconfirmed, acceptance-tier-failed, acceptance-tier-owner-decision, acceptance-tier-code-owner, acceptance-tier-highest, acceptance-tier-spec-pr, acceptance-tier-self-merge, acceptance-tier-order-waits, acceptance-tier-relayed, acceptance-tier-three-waits.

## Not in scope

The daily merge digest and veto (acceptance-merge-digest, acceptance-merge-digest-veto) and the lane-start brake (acceptance-lane-start-usage, -room, -clear, -unread, -carried): their own lanes.
